title: Chinna
desc: Chinna, a gangster, changes his way of life after he falls in love with Gayatri. However, he ends up in jail after he kills a gang leader in order to save Gayatri.

title: Anjatha Singam
desc: When a cop gets wrongly accused of murder and imprisoned for life, his son sets out to find the real culprit and clear his father's name.

title: Pudhayal
desc: Madhu steals a treasure map during an archaeological expedition and sends it to a gang. However, Swapna intercepts the map and decides to find the treasure on her own.

title: Thanthu Vitten Ennai
desc: Raju, an unemployed young man, falls in love with Surya, a girl from an affluent family. However, when her father asks him to get a job before their marriage, his life becomes challenging.

title: Iyer Ips
desc: A deputy commissioner strives to establish justice by any means necessary. However, trouble arises when a gangster vows to kill him.
